name: ServiceReminderCampaignPlanner
tagline: Every vehicle reminded at the right time – by date, mileage or inspection – and every reminder turned into a workshop booking.
description: Complete dealer service-retention app for Canvas, Model-driven apps and Power Pages: calculate when each vehicle is due by time, mileage forecast and inspection date, segment customers into overdue, due, inspection and lapsed campaigns, launch SMS / email / letter campaigns or advisor call lists, log contact attempts with consent, cooldown and maximum-attempt rules, book and complete the service, and measure booking conversion, booked value and lost-customer win-back.
features: Due date by time, mileage forecast or inspection date
Campaign segments: overdue, due now, due soon, inspection, lapsed
Campaign launch with eligible audience, exclusions and preview
SMS / email / phone / letter contact log with outcomes
Booking with advisor, date rules and RO value
Mark serviced restarts the reminder cycle
Booking conversion, attempts per booking and channel performance
